answer.value: The card describes the training approach only briefly (cold-start SFT with long reasoning traces, then RL scaling with GRPO) and does not explain how or why key design choices were made; it defers to external blogpost/technical report.
quotes: Built on top of [Falcon-H1-7B-Base](https://huggingface.co/tiiuae/Falcon-H1-7B-Base), it was trained via cold-start supervised fine-tuning with long reasoning traces and further enhanced by scaling RL with GRPO.

For more details about the training protocol of this model, please refer to the [Falcon-H1R technical blogpost](https://falcon-lm.github.io/blog/falcon-h1r-7b) and [Technical Report](https://github.com/tiiuae/falcon-h1r/blob/main/tech_report.pdf).
